subject.title: fix: native landing accepts validation-empty draft CI

question: Should `scripts/pr` landing reject workflow-level CI success unless exact-head canonical CI preflight and substantive validation jobs succeeded, and re-run hosted evidence checks immediately before merge?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but this changes merge-gate security behavior and the issue carries protected maintainer/security labels, so a maintainer should explicitly own the policy direction.

options.title: Patch landing gates now
options.body: Update hosted prepare and merge verification to require job-level CI evidence for the exact head and add regression coverage for the draft-to-ready sequence.

options.title: Rely on branch protection
options.body: Keep `scripts/pr` narrower and require repository settings to enforce checks, accepting that the wrapper remains unsafe when required checks are absent.

options.title: Pause for broader landing redesign
options.body: Hold this for a larger maintainer-owned merge-policy redesign if the desired fix spans more than the reported draft-CI hole.

recommendation.title: Patch landing gates now
recommendation.body: Update hosted prepare and merge verification to require job-level CI evidence for the exact head and add regression coverage for the draft-to-ready sequence.

likelyOwner.reason: This login is both the reporter and the current blame/recent history owner for the affected landing-script and CI workflow paths.
